about.heading: About Rahul
about.bio: Rahul V R comes from a background in app development and sales, but acting has always been his true passion. What began as a creative outlet during the Covid lockdown — making short videos on TikTok — steadily grew into a dedicated pursuit of performance. He carried that momentum onto Instagram Reels, building an audience through consistent, expressive content, and has since turned that experience into a growing career in acting.
